I feared I was going to have to stick with synthetic because all the other “real human hair” bangs were just utterly ridiculous. I use them for side swept bangs and noone knows the difference. I bought the dark drown and dyed them to match my particular dark brown color and it blends perfectly. I wash them as I do my hair and they are very durable!

Gorgeous. It’s hard not put snap in bangs in everyday once you try them. Truly a game changer and confidence builder.  I only get real hair and these are beautiful. I noticed on the clip that this one snaps on with the clip going down and on the others I have the clip snaps in going up. I read another reviewer’s review on another pair of snap in bangs and she said

These are great! They come out of packaging a little flat so I just run them over a little with my curler so they are a little more voluminous! They matched perfectly to my natural hair 10/10 very cute and entertaining during this quarantine lol
I need  cover a bald spot on top and this just didn't cover it. The price is good so I'm keeping it. I may be able to use it in conjunction with some else.

reviews.t: Would be perfect if it was lighter.
reviews.x: I bought the air side swept bangs to supplement my natural thinning bangs.  The brown is reddish, matches my hair perfectly when I first dye it but as the red fades it is too dark.  I was able to buy a second one and lighten it a bit.  I bought a third and bleached it out but ended up too red.  I would really love these in a blonde that I can dye to match.  I tried another brand in blonde and was able to color it but the quality was not as good as this brand.

I really like this product my hair is thin on top and has gray so this covers it if you’re in between touchups. I’d also like to see if they have little side bangs. Works great for if you wanna pull your hair up in a high ponytail
I almost had myself convinced to get long bangs.  I ordered this and after wearing it around the house for the night - dodged that bullet of a bang cut.  This product is Meh, but worth every penny.

I use this to thicken my side bangs. I just received this and had to work at it to get it in just the right place so I would have enough hair to blend with it.  It works fine but does require some work . Other have complained about how thin it is but it’s just right for me…it looks natural and adds just enough to give my hair some fullness. My hair is dark brown but I purchased natural black and it blends fine.

This can not be put at the bun like how it shows on photo. It has to be at the end to have a sweep and the bun at the top. NOT satisfied at ALL. Need a refund. The clip should be at the bun and then long enough to sweep.. NOT a good buy

Came about a day after I order! I styled it to my face, but other than that it blends really well with my hair. The clip also doesn't hurt to put in.  The product was worth the price. I would definitely recommend it.

reviews.t: The hair is too straight for African American hair
reviews.x: The hair is too straight for African American hair. If I did not pop it open I would have sent it back. In the junk pile it goes.

reviews.t: No lice in mine. Is it worth the shot for you?
reviews.x: This is a great product. Pretty well made. HOWEVER I had a s*** ton of anxiety having to open it after reading all the reviews about lice and lice eggs. Word of advice. Do what I did. It should come in a sealed plastic ziplock bag. Open the package OUTSIDE and then look through the plastic first without opening that. I read the reviews so I was prepared to open outside just in case. Once I saw nothing on the hair. I opened up the bag and looked through the entire thing for any white spots. I did

reviews.t: I think my new bangs are the cats meow.
reviews.x: I Took a chance on ordering this specific product. As you know their are lots of choices. I couldn’t be happier with the color & weight of the bangs. I haven’t had to do anything except clip them in and enjoy how great they look. I am in my mid-60’s with some thinning so anything I can do that is affordable and easy is a winner to me 👍.

I position this to add volume to an area where traction alopecia thinned one section of my hairline.  I otherwise have shoulder length average thickness hair when in a silk press.  It matches my natural hair in a silk press perfectly and no one ever suspects anything except that my front now matches the thickness of the back and sides.

I’m trying to grow my bangs out as I’m not use to bangs and it was a bad idea for me . This little piece does the trick and at a great price . I was nervous with the other reviews about lice so I opened it outside and no lice here ! Hopefully the company fixed that issue .

reviews.t: The photo looks better than the delivered item
reviews.x: I am returning this item. Appearance: Great color; but the hair was very thin and not as luxurious as advertised. Quality: Lots of straggly ends Fit:  Although I did not attach it to my hair, It would be great fit for a doll baby Price:Not worth the price for my needs

This was a great product but it is more of a red dark brown. It was the wrong color for me. I am normally a 2 or 4 in brown hair colors so I returned this product but got a natural black which was much closer to my hair color.

claims.text: Many reviewers love these bangs and say they boost confidence, especially for covering hair loss or thinning bangs.
Several reviewers report finding lice or lice eggs in the product.
Reviewers praise the quality and natural look of the human hair, saying it blends well and matches their color.
Some reviewers say the actual color differs noticeably from the photos, often appearing more red or auburn.
A few reviewers note the bangs are thin or don't provide enough coverage for larger bald spots.
